title: Maintain provenance and disposition for fork-specific patches
summary: Maintain a reviewable ledger linking independently maintained fork patches to their originating change, purpose, upstream issue or commit when known, and current status such as pending, upstreamed, superseded or deliberately retained; update it when patches are changed, rebased or retired.
statement: Maintain a reviewable ledger linking independently maintained fork patches to their originating change, purpose, upstream issue or commit when known, and current status such as pending, upstreamed, superseded or deliberately retained; update it when patches are changed, rebased or retired.
rationale: Independent normalization of SPEC-0135. Track purpose, origin, upstreaming state, retained changes and patch disposition. Existing overlapping general rules remain independently selectable.

conditions: When a Rust fork retains independently maintained patches.
exceptions: The reviewable ledger can live in files, commit notes or issue metadata; no single file format is mandatory.
